tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Request cancellation of the running job. Returns the job id and the state; `cancelled: false` when there was nothing to cancel (that is not an error).

tools.name: detect
tools.description: Stage 1 only: detect text blocks and return the boxes, skipping OCR. Runs the same single-flight job path as run_pipeline (so it is BUSY while a job is running) and shows the boxes on the canvas. Overrides are applied to the live config.

allow_dynamic.description: Dynamic input size (tall pages: more boxes, slower).
allow_dynamic.title: Allow Dynamic

tools.guiEffect: boxes drawn on the output canvas

tools.name: export_config
tools.description: Return the live config; if `path` is given, also write it there (parents created). `redact_secrets` replaces secret values (mcp.auth_token) with the `<redacted>` placeholder in the file and in the reply, and lists what it hid.

path.description: Optional file to write the JSON to.
path.title: Path

redact_secrets.description: Replace secrets with the <redacted> placeholder. Importing such a file keeps the app's current token instead of setting the literal placeholder.
redact_secrets.title: Redact Secrets

tools.name: get_annotated_image
tools.description: The current result drawn over the page, as a PNG image content block; metadata (size, block count, scale) comes back as structured content.

scale.description: Render scale (1.0 = full resolution of the source page).
scale.title: Scale

outputSchema.description:
Metadata for the PNG that travels as MCP *image content*; the pixels are never part
of the structured content (a full-resolution page would swamp a chat context).
outputSchema.title: AnnotatedImageMeta

tools.name: get_config
tools.description: The live configuration document (config.schema.json, schema_version 1.2).

tools.name: get_image_info
tools.description: The current page: source, file name, size and sha256. NO_IMAGE when nothing is loaded.

tools.name: get_result
tools.description: The latest result document (result.schema.json, schema_version 1.2); `block_ids` returns only those blocks (INVALID_ARGUMENT when none of them exist). Each block carries `flags` (`possible_truncation`) and `contained_in` (id of the tightest larger box covering it) — observations, never edits.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: App state in one call: version, job state and progress, loaded engines and device, the current image, the on-premises model report and MCP counters.

tools.name: highlight_block
tools.description: Select a block: the canvas box is marked, its hover panel shows its text, the table row and the JSON pane follow. The panel clears after `duration_ms` (default 1500).

id.description: Block id from the result document.
id.title: Id

duration_ms.description: How long the hover panel stays up.
duration_ms.title: Duration Ms

tools.name: import_config
tools.description: Replace the whole configuration from `json` (a config document) or from `path` — exactly one of the two. Widgets, canvas and pipeline all follow it; `restart_required` lists any MCP transport key the file changed that only takes effect on the next start.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: The five AnimeText YOLO variants with params/F1/recommended thresholds, plus bundled / loaded / available flags from the on-premises model bundle.

tools.name: load_image
tools.description: Load a page into the app from `path`, from `base64_png_jpg`, or from the desktop clipboard (`from_clipboard`: GUI only) — exactly one of the three.

path.description: Image file on the app's machine.
path.title: Path

base64_png_jpg.description: PNG/JPEG/WebP bytes, base64 (a data: URL is accepted).
base64_png_jpg.title: Base64 Png Jpg

from_clipboard.description: Take the image from the desktop clipboard (needs the GUI).
from_clipboard.title: From Clipboard

file_name.description: Name to record for a base64 payload.
file_name.title: File Name

tools.name: reocr_blocks
tools.description: Re-read selected blocks of the current document without detecting again: crop the named boxes, OCR only those, and return a whole new result document (same boxes, ids, colours and reading order; new created_at/timing_ms; `stage: 'reocr'`). The way to act on `flags: ["possible_truncation"]` — usually with an `ocr` override raising `max_new_tokens`. Needs a loaded page and a result; BUSY while a job runs.

block_ids.description: Block ids to read again, e.g. [7] or [3, 7] — the ids from the result document. Unknown ids are an INVALID_ARGUMENT listing what is available.
block_ids.title: Block Ids

ocr.description: OCR section overrides for this read only: max_new_tokens, crop_padding_px, batch_size, device, normalize_nfkc.
ocr.title: Ocr

include_annotated_image.description: Also return the annotated PNG as MCP image content.
include_annotated_image.title: Include Annotated Image

tools.guiEffect: progress bar; the named blocks change text, the rest of the page is untouched

tools.name: reset
tools.description: Throw the page away: clears the image, the result, the canvas, the table and the JSON pane. BUSY while a job is running (cancel_job first).

tools.name: run_pipeline
tools.description: Full run on the loaded page: detect -> order -> crop -> OCR. Returns the result document (§2.1) and, with include_annotated_image, the overlay PNG as image content. Sends MCP progress notifications while the GUI progress bar moves. Any override is applied to the live config first, so the GUI shows what actually ran.

ocr.description: OCR section overrides: device, max_patches, batch_size, max_new_tokens, crop_padding_px, normalize_nfkc.
ocr.title: Ocr

include_annotated_image.description: Also return the annotated PNG as MCP image content.
include_annotated_image.title: Include Annotated Image

tools.guiEffect: progress bar, boxes appear, JSON pane fills

tools.name: save_result
tools.description: Write the latest result document to `path` on the app's machine.

tools.name: set_config
tools.description: Apply a partial config: {"detection": {"score_threshold": 0.3}}. Sections and keys you leave out keep their current values; invalid values fail with INVALID_CONFIG and change nothing. Returns the full config, the list of changed key paths, and `restart_required`: changed keys the running process cannot re-apply (the MCP bind address, port, transport and bearer token are read once, at server start). The value is stored either way — the socket you are talking to has not moved.

patch.description: Partial config object (one or more sections).
patch.title: Patch

tools.name: set_overlay_visible
tools.description: Show/hide the box overlay, the labels, or set the fill opacity. Applies to the canvas and to the gui.* config section at once (so it exports and imports).

tools.name: set_zoom
tools.description: Zoom the output canvas: mode "fit", or "percent" with percent 10..800.

tools.name: unload_engines
tools.description: Free the detector and OCR models (waits for the running job). The next run loads them again — useful when the GPU is shared. Note: the model objects are released and that memory becomes reusable, but ONNX Runtime keeps a few hundred MB of process-wide state that is only returned when the process exits.

tools.name: warm_engines
tools.description: Start the engine warm-up job — `--preload`'s remote twin, and the counterpart of `unload_engines`. Loads the weights AND runs one throwaway inference per engine, so the first real page is not slower than every page after it. Returns immediately with the job id (BUSY if a job is already running); poll `get_status`, where `job.kind == 'warmup'` and `engines[].warm` is the proof. `probe: false` loads without the inference: from a cold engine that leaves `loaded: true, warm: false`.

probe.description: Run the throwaway first inference (default true). False = load the weights only.
probe.title: Probe

outputSchema.description: The warm-up is a job, so this answers with a job handle, not with a wait (P8.3).

note.default: poll get_status (job.kind == 'warmup'); get_status.engines[].warm is the proof
note.title: Note

outputSchema.title: WarmEnginesResult

tools.guiEffect: progress bar runs the `warmup` job; engines badge refreshes when it finishes

resources.name: current-config
resources.title: Live configuration
resources.description: The whole configuration document the app is running with (config.schema.json).

resources.name: latest-result
resources.title: Latest result document
resources.description: The result JSON of the most recent successful run (§2.1). NO_IMAGE when there is none.

resources.name: current-image
resources.title: Current page (PNG)
resources.description: The loaded page as PNG, untouched by the overlay.

resources.name: annotated-image
resources.title: Annotated page (PNG)
resources.description: The page with the current boxes drawn on it, at full resolution.

resources.name: model-list
resources.title: Model catalogue
resources.description: The five YOLO variants with bundled/loaded/available flags.

resources.name: mcp-log
resources.title: MCP activity log
resources.description: Recent tool calls: time, tool, arguments (redacted), outcome, duration.
